tabs.html:
HUAWEI eKit S310-24ST4X 24 x GE SFP Ports, 8 SFP Dual-Purpose 10/100/1000, 4x 10GE SFP+ Ports L2+ Hybrid Managed Switch


24 x GE SFP ports, 8 of which are dual-purpose 10/100/1000 or SFP, 4*10GE SFP+ ports | built-in AC power | Packet forwarding rate: 96 Mpps | Switching capacity: 128 Gbit/s


The Huawei eKit S310-24ST4X is a Layer 2+ hybrid managed switch designed to deliver high-performance, secure, and scalable connectivity for enterprise and ISP networks. Equipped with 24 x GE SFP ports, including 8 dual-purpose (combo) ports that support both copper and fiber connections, and 4 x 10GE SFP+ uplink ports, this switch ensures fast and flexible data transmission.

Built for carrier-grade environments, the S310-24ST4X supports advanced management protocols, robust security features, and industrial-grade reliability, making it suitable for core aggregation, FTTH, campus, or datacenter deployments.


Key Features:

  • Ports:

    • 24 x GE SFP ports (8 combo 10/100/1000 Base-T/SFP)

    • 4 x 10GE SFP+ uplink ports

  • Switching Capacity: Up to 128 Gbps

  • Forwarding Rate: 95 Mpps

  • Management: Web UI, CLI, SNMP, RMON, Telnet

  • Layer 2+ Features: VLANs, STP/RSTP/MSTP, QinQ, Link Aggregation, Port Mirroring

  • Security: DHCP Snooping, ARP Inspection, ACL, Port Isolation

  • Industrial Reliability: Fanless design, lightning protection, stable operation

  • Mounting: Rack-mountable


Ideal For:

  • ISP Core or Distribution Layer

  • Enterprise or Business Network Aggregation

  • Fiber to the Home (FTTH) Edge Deployments

  • Educational Institutions & Campus Networks

  • CCTV/IP Surveillance Backhaul
